title: Occupational Correlation & Predictive Modeling for Cardiovascular Disease (2015-2021)
summary: A health-survey analytics project studying links between occupation and cardiovascular disease and building predictive models for CVD risk. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, run via the sdv.single_table API, to generate synthetic minority-class samples to correct CVD-positive class imbalance before model training.
evidence: GANs.ipynb:784-787 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' and :944-946 GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, both fit on data
